message: From now on, when you mention a plan limit, always give the number for every plan side by side, not just the one I asked about.
数据导出支持哪些格式？另外以后给我的答案里不要放表格，我在手机上看，表格会乱。
We've decided: customers on the Team plan get a 14-day grace period after a failed card renewal instead of 7. Starting next month.
我们定了，飞书集成先只给企业版开放，商业版暂时不开。你帮我看看 SSO 现在是哪些套餐能用？

Heads up for whoever handles SSO next: the Okta login loop we saw today was caused by the customer's clock being 6 minutes off. SAML assertions expire after 5 minutes, so fixing NTP on their IdP server solved it.
刚帮一个客户做完工作区迁移，踩了个坑：附件超过 200MB 的导出包会被浏览器中断，最后是分三批按文件夹导出才成功的。

Decision: we will not offer data residency in Singapore this year. And please keep answering me with the ticket link at the end, that works well for me. What does the data residency page say about Frankfurt?
Just for this answer, give me the sync conflict steps as a numbered list.
如果我们把免费版的笔记上限从 100 改成 200，会影响哪些地方？只是想想，还没定。
How does the dunning process work when a card renewal fails?
以后跟我说设备参数的时候，单位统一用公制，温度用摄氏度，别给我华氏度。
What is the OEE target for line L2? Also, going forward please always state which shift a number refers to, I compare shifts a lot.
We agreed in today's review: preventive maintenance on the CNC spindles moves from every 500 to every 400 running hours, effective Monday.
决定了：焊接机器人 ROB-11 的喷嘴改成每两个班清理一次，每班清理太耽误产量了，先试一个月。
记一下这次的教训：主轴过热不是轴承的问题，是冷却液浓度掉到了 3%，配到 6% 以后温度就正常了。下次先测冷却液浓度再拆主轴。
Lesson from the L1 changeover today: pre-staging the dies on the cart before the line stops cut the changeover from 42 to 18 minutes. The SMED page doesn't mention the cart.
昨天 CNC-07 换轴承的时候发现备件库存只剩 1 个了，差点停线。所以我们决定 6206 轴承的安全库存从 2 个提到 4 个。
Keep this one short please: what does LOTO stand for?
周工说他喜欢看振动频谱图，你那边有振动分析的资料吗？
Which machines on line L2 use the P-BRG-6205 bearing?
Please always give me appointment times in 24-hour format from now on, I keep misreading AM and PM.
取消预约的规定是什么？以后涉及收费的地方都帮我把医保能报销的部分单独列出来。
我们决定周六儿科加开下午门诊，13:00 到 17:00，下个月开始。
We're going ahead with direct billing for AXA from 1 November. What does the direct billing page say we need from the insurer?
Note for the team: three pre-authorisations were rejected this week because the diagnosis code was missing its fourth character. Adding the full ICD-10 code fixed all three on resubmission.
外籍患者登记又遇到问题了：护照上的名字顺序和保险卡不一致，系统匹配不上。后来按保险卡的顺序录入就好了，以后都这么处理。
Two things: we decided asthma follow-ups can be done online after the second in-person visit, not the first. And when you summarise rules for me, put the exceptions first.
假如患者迟到 20 分钟，按现在的规定算爽约吗？
Answer in Chinese this time, I need to forward it to a patient's family: what are the telemedicine rules for prescriptions?
调取病历需要患者签什么文件？
Going forward, whenever you mention a merchant, include its merchant ID in brackets. I search the dashboard by ID.
拒付原因码 4837 是什么意思？还有，金额以后都带上币种，别只写数字。
定了：茶馆那个子商户的结算周期从 T+1 改成 T+3，观察三个月再说。
I've decided to lower the rolling reserve for VoltRide from 10% to 5% now that their chargeback rate is under 0.5%.
Worth remembering: the false-positive fraud blocks on Monday all came from one corporate VPN exit IP. Allowlisting the IP range for that merchant stopped them; the risk score itself was fine.
退款到已注销的卡这次又碰到了，发卡行要 7 个工作日才会退回，客服别承诺 3 天到账，要先告诉客户这个时间。

The card-testing attack last night used BIN 457173 again. We blocked it within 20 minutes thanks to the velocity rule, so we're keeping the velocity threshold at 5 attempts per minute instead of raising it.
跨境交易的汇率是什么时候锁定的？
If we raised the velocity threshold to 8 attempts per minute, which recent attacks would we have missed? Just exploring.
这次回答用英文，我要贴到给海外合作方的邮件里：KYC 需要哪些材料？
以后说到促销规则，先给结论，再讲例外情况，我老是被一大段规则绕晕。
What's the SLA for shipping to remote areas? And from now on please give me deadlines as dates, not as 'within N days'.
双十二的优惠券预算我们定了，总共 30 万，平台券和店铺券各一半。
Decision on seller S303: we're suspending their listings for 7 days after the third counterfeit complaint, not just issuing another warning.
Lesson learned on address changes after payment: if the parcel has already been handed to the carrier, cancelling and reshipping is faster than the carrier's redirect, which took 5 days this time.
今天又处理了一个优惠券叠加出错的单子，原因是满减门槛用了原价算，应该用券后价。系统里那个开关在活动设置的高级选项里，以后先检查那里。
部分退款的运费，复购客户我们决定以后都由平台承担。另外你回答我的时候订单号放在最前面。
Which membership tier gets free returns?
王总说他喜欢看英文的报告，那发票开具规则有英文版的说明吗？
Give me just a yes or no this time: can a coupon be used on a pre-sale item?
When you quote transit times for me, always give the range for both sea and rail, I nearly always compare the two.
危险品锂电池怎么申报？另外以后给我说 HS 编码的时候都写到 10 位，我报关要用。
We've decided that every shipment above 50,000 USD gets all-risk cargo insurance by default, whatever the customer's Incoterm.
欧洲中小客户默认走 DDP 这个做法我们决定扩到英国客户。英国那边清关有什么特别要注意的吗？
记一下：这次冷链断链是因为温度记录仪的电池在转运时没电了，数据断了 6 小时，保险公司拒赔。以后出发前要检查记录仪电量，至少 80%。
For the record: Rotterdam congestion again this week. Rerouting via Antwerp added 2 days but saved 9 days of waiting; the customer agreed once we sent the three cost options in writing.
海关扣货这次是因为发票上的货值和报关单差了 2%，我们决定以后所有出口单在提交前都由单证组二次核对发票和报关单。
Suppose a customer ships under FOB and the container is damaged at the origin port: who pays? Just checking my understanding.
滞箱费是从哪天开始算的？
Use a table for this one: what documents does a dangerous goods shipment need?
I've taken over all the enterprise accounts in the EU as of this week, so most of my questions will be about those customers. What's the data residency situation for EU workspaces?
我现在调到武汉厂上夜班了，以后问的基本都是武汉那几台 CNC。武汉 CNC-07 用的是什么轴承？
I'm only working at the Pudong clinic from now on, the Jing'an one is no longer mine. Which insurers do we bill directly?
我现在主要负责东南亚的商户了，新加坡和马来西亚那边。跨境交易的汇率是怎么算的？
Just so you know, I'm in charge of the cross-border store now, not the mainland one. What's our refund policy for cross-border orders?
我这边以后主要做冷链，医药和生鲜的出口都归我了。冷链的温度标准是多少？
